name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service Coastal Program (FY26 cooperative agreements)
summary: Cooperative agreements for projects that protect and restore fish and wildlife habitat on public and private coastal lands. Applicants must contact a local Coastal Program office first; land acquisition is not funded.

geography.label: Priority coastal ecosystems of the United States

eligibility.rule: Aligns with the regional strategic implementation plans or program priorities
Does not generate compensatory mitigation credits or accept mitigation or in-lieu funds as non-Federal cost share
Does not acquire land; title searches and real estate appraisals are allowed
Does not include foreign travel, pre-award costs, unauthorized equipment or excess indirect costs
Is registered in SAM.gov, unless applying as a natural person
Is not prohibited, restricted or excluded from receiving or participating in an award

documents: SF-424A budget information form for non-construction projects
SF-424C budget information form for construction projects
SF-429 real-property request form, if applicable
SF-LLL disclosure of lobbying activities, if applicable
DOI R&D Current and Pending Other Support form, if required for research projects
DOI R&D Biographical Sketch form, if required for research projects
Most recently negotiated indirect cost rate agreement, if previously negotiated

applicant_types.quote: State governments Business For-profit organizations other than small businesses Small businesses Nonprofit Other Native American tribal organizations Nonprofits non-higher education without 501(c)(3) Nonprofits non-higher education with 501(c)(3) Miscellaneous Individuals Unrestricted Education Independent school districts Private institutions of higher education

geography.quote: projects that protect and restore fish and wildlife habitats on public and private lands in priority coastal ecosystems

access.quote: We require that all interested applicants contact their local Coastal Program office before submitting an application.

effort.quote: We require that all interested applicants contact their local Coastal Program office before submitting an application.
Electronically submitted applications from invited applicants must be submitted no later than 11:59 PM, ET, 09/30/2026.
During the eligibility review, the application is checked for timely submission, completed packages (see Application Documents above) and alignment with the requirements of this announcement.
Merit review is conducted by local and regional program staff.
Prior to making an award, the applicant will be assessed for their level of risk per 2 CFR 200.206.

eligibility.quote: Do not align with the regional strategic implementation plans or program priorities.
Generate compensatory mitigation credits under a Federal or state regulatory program or accept mitigation or in-lieu funds as non-Federal cost share for a project.
Acquire land although it can support title searches and real estate appraisals.
Include foreign travel, pre-award costs, purchase of unauthorized equipment, indirect costs in excess of the negotiated indirect cost rate or the de minimus indirect cost rate.
Before applying, all applicants except individuals applying as a natural person must be registered in SAM.gov.

We are prohibited from making an award if a recipient or any key personnel are found ineligible, prohibited, restricted, or otherwise excluded from receiving or participating in an award, as their ineligibility condition applies to this program.

after_award.quote: Submit Federal Financial reports and Program Performance reports.

documents.quote: SF-424A, Budget Information - Non-Construction Programs Required for non-construction projects SF-424C: Budget Information - Construction Programs Required for construction projects SF-429 (Cover Page & Attachment B), Request to Acquire, Improve, or Furnish Real Property

Project Abstract Summary (OMB 4040-0019). Must include, in plain language: • Award purpose, • Activities to be performed, Required from all applicants • Expected deliverables or outcomes, • Intended beneficiaries, Subrecipient activities (if known or specified at time of award) DOI Research and Development (R&D) - Current and Pending (Other) Support

DOI Research and Development (R&D) - Biographical Sketch Note: This form is available on the DOI website. Applicants must download the form and include the completed form as an application attachment. Required for research projects. Project Narrative
attach a copy of the most recently negotiated rate agreement (active or expired).
